care_adaptive.name: CARE-Adaptive
care_adaptive.description: Dynamic capability recomputation + micro-eval candidate ranking + sequential transactional commit

care_static.name: CARE-Static
care_static.description: Frozen initial capability ranking + micro-eval candidate ranking + sequential transactional commit

random.name: Random-K5 Control
random.description: Uniform random K=5 candidate nomination + micro-eval transactional commit

reap_prune.name: REAP-Prune
reap_prune.description: Router-weighted activation saliency accumulation and physical expert deletion (pruning without parameter fusion)

sub_moe.name: Sub-MoE
sub_moe.description: Characteristic activation / router proxy clustering with frequency-weighted singular component reconstruction or direct averaging

hc_smoe.name: HC-SMoE
hc_smoe.description: Lance-Williams hierarchical agglomerative clustering using router-cosine or weight-proxy dissimilarity

mc_smoe.name: MC-SMoE
mc_smoe.description: Routing-guided core expert selection with bipartite Hungarian matching (Stages 1-4 only; Stage 5 low-rank SVD residual pruning omitted)
